scenes.title: Your road. In view.
scenes.subtitle: Speed limits, Dashcam and street imagery with YouSpeed.

scenes.title: Mount it. Set it up.
scenes.subtitle: Before driving, secure the phone and keep the rear camera unobstructed.

scenes.title: Choose your mounting position
scenes.subtitle: Open Settings. Choose portrait or the matching landscape position.

scenes.title: Align the camera before driving
scenes.subtitle: Tap the viewfinder. Align the horizon and lane guides, then Save.

scenes.title: Enable camera recognition
scenes.subtitle: Allow camera access. Install regional data in Data Manager, then enable sign recognition.

scenes.title: Start your drive recording
scenes.subtitle: Tap the red recorder. Dashcam and your enabled camera features start together.

scenes.title: Keep the drive
scenes.subtitle: Real iPhone Dashcam footage, saved locally for playback and sharing.

scenes.title: Stop. Save. Play.
scenes.subtitle: Tap the recorder again to stop. Open Gallery → Videos to replay or share.

scenes.title: Choose when pictures are captured
scenes.subtitle: Enable Capture pictures. Set a distance or time interval; photos stay on your device.

scenes.title: See the places you pass
scenes.subtitle: After your drive, open Gallery → Pictures. Review photos and mark favourites.

scenes.title: Review first. Share when ready.
scenes.subtitle: Select your pictures, then tap Upload. Connect a Panoramax account in Settings first.

scenes.title: Camera-based speed limits
scenes.subtitle: Example camera result: the eye marks a camera-supplied limit. A regional model is required.

scenes.title: More than speed limits
scenes.subtitle: Example recognition display: additional road signs appear beside the limit.

scenes.title: Ready for the road
scenes.subtitle: Configure while parked. Keep your attention on the road and follow posted signs.
